item.title: Gohoushi Akuma to Oshioki Tenshi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Quince Soft
  • 発売日: 2021-01-29
  • スコア: 6.49/10 (24 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ごほうしアクマとオシオキてんし
  • 英語名: Gohoushi Akuma to Oshioki Tenshi

别名

  • ごましお

あらすじ

A world not too far from ours…

In this world, apart from the human world where people live, there existed a heavenly world and a demon world.

People live peacefully without knowing about such things.

Doumae Reiya, is a student who lives in a hot spring inn on a remote island, and is the son of the inn’s proprietress. However, he and his childhood friend, Kohanai Touka, are worried about the depopulation of the island where they were born and raised.

item.title: Mono no Aware wa Sai no Koro.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Quince Soft
  • 発売日: 2017-09-29
  • スコア: 8.05/10 (108 人評価)
  • 日本語名: もののあはれは彩の頃。
  • 英語名: Mono no Aware wa Sai no Koro.

别名

  • 彩頃

あらすじ

All Japanese people know the rules of e-sugoroku: roll the dice, move your piece, aim for the finish. However, for Akira and those around him who have also lost their memories, they have become the ‘pieces’ in a world that mimics this game. They have to compete with each other to be the first and only one to reach the finish line and escape the world.
